response.original_title: Can I add a person to my Carnival Cruise booking?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can add a person to an existing Carnival Cruise booking, as long as your stateroom and the ship have the extra capacity. Your room must be rated to hold the extra guest (for example, a room that sleeps four can add a fourth person). The overall ship and the lifeboat station (muster zone) must also have space available. Call Directly: You cannot add a passenger online or through the mobile app. You must call Carnival customer service +1-866-829-1280(US) or your travel agent.
